generated_description:
PRECIOSA ORNELA BUGLE BEAD #2 (4.5mm) - 05051 WHITE SATIN

These Czech Bugle Beads are made by Preciosa Ornela in the Czech Republic, sized #2 (4.5mm long, 1.9mm in diameter). Unlike a seed bead, the elongated tube shape of a bugle bead adds a sleek, linear texture instead of a rounded one. This White Satin color has a soft, milky white tone finished with a soft satin coating that mutes the shine into a smooth, frosted glow rather than a glossy or transparent finish.

  • Color: White Satin
  • Size: #2 (4.5mm long x 1.9mm diameter)
  • Mini-pack: Approximately 38 grams
  • Factory pack: 1/2 Kilo (500 grams)

The elongated tube shape and dense satin color make these beads a popular choice for fringe, loom and peyote stitch beadwork, bead embroidery, and mixed strand jewelry designs where a soft, milky white satin accent color is appreciated.
